environmentVariables.name: ATLASO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the .atlaso/ store. If unset, atlaso walks up from the current working directory looking for an existing .atlaso/ or a project marker (pyproject.toml, package.json, .git, Cargo.toml, go.mod) and creates the store there. Falls back to the cwd as a last resort. Never falls back to $HOME.
